origin: Original deterministic procedural synthesis; no third-party recordings, samples, or melodies.

cues.description: Thick batter falling onto hot iron: wet body, three soft plops, short pan contact.
cues.trigger: A successful automatic measured batter pour.

cues.description: T-spreader dragging through wet batter with a restrained metal-on-iron edge.
cues.trigger: Accepted distance-sampled batter or egg spreading movement.

cues.description: Seamless hot-iron cooking bed with many small moisture crackles.
cues.trigger: Loops while poured batter is actively cooking; heat and moisture drive level and pitch.

cues.description: Spatula lift, brief pancake whoosh, iron tap, and soft landing.
Wet sauce brush dragging across a cooked pancake.
cues.trigger: A brush sample that actually applies sauce to new cells.

cues.description: Cooked pancake rustle, crease, and soft fold landing.
cues.trigger: Each successfully committed left or right fold.

cues.description: Wrapped order slide, counter set-down, and restrained two-note service accent.
cues.trigger: A valid serve action that opens the customer result.

cues.description: Seamless restrained breakfast-street bed: distant traffic air, room tone, and sparse birds.
cues.trigger: Loops while the live workstation scene is open.

cues.description: Soft entrance step and a short two-tone counter chime.
cues.trigger: A new customer order enters an active service slot.

cues.description: Two dry counter taps with a muted warning tone; informative rather than alarming.
cues.trigger: An order crosses the critical patience threshold for the first time.

cues.description: Several small coins gathered from the counter with a restrained bright finish.
cues.trigger: Pending customer payment is successfully collected.

cues.description: Soft dough pieces landing in a wire fryer basket.
cues.trigger: Youtiao dough is successfully loaded into the fryer.

cues.description: Fryer basket entering hot oil with a fast rising burst of bubbles.
cues.trigger: A loaded fryer lane successfully starts cooking.

cues.description: Wire basket lift, oil drip, and a small readiness ping.
cues.trigger: A ready fryer basket is successfully lifted or stored.

cues.description: Paper cup lifted from its stack and placed beneath a nozzle.
cues.trigger: An empty soy-milk cup is successfully placed.

cues.description: Warm soy milk flowing into a paper cup with a soft machine hum.
cues.trigger: A manual or automatic soy-milk dispense begins.

cues.description: Liquid flow stops, cup settles, and the machine gives a gentle ready click.
A packaged juice carton placed firmly into its display tray.
cues.trigger: At least one packaged drink restock unit completes.

cues.description: A carton slides free of the display tray with a light paper rustle.
cues.trigger: A stocked packaged drink begins a delivery drag.
